_why: Memory is split into rooms so a wake-up bundle never cuts a room in half.
_rule: This file is the single source of truth for room size contracts. Generators must enforce max_chars; readers use read_when to decide what to open. A full room requires a reviewed proposal before distillation.
_when: boot is loaded at every wake; operations is opened before memory work; story is opened when the user asks about the companion's history or continuity.

operations.title: Agent Operations
operations.read_when: before writing durable memory, distilling, or drafting formal notes

story.title: Agent Story
story.read_when: when the user asks about continuity, history, or why this agent exists
